morphology.pattern_note: 按资料包指定基底作表层切分；词族基词为 perhati。首两个 e 均读 /ə/，末尾 -ian 可读 /i.an/。本词表示观察活动，不表示观察者。

senses.zh_definition: 观察；有意识地仔细察看、留意或研究事物的活动。
senses.en_definition: The act or process of observing or examining something attentively.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal memerhatikan, usaha, dsb memerhatikan atau mengamati sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 侧重实际察看与观察过程；perhatian 更侧重注意力或关注。berdasarkan pemerhatian saya 可引出个人观察所得，并不自动表示结论已获证实。释义依据：[PRPM：pemerhatian](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pemerhatian)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Berdasarkan pemerhatian di lokasi, pasukan penyelidik mendapati bahawa kesesakan lalu lintas paling teruk berlaku pada waktu petang.
dual_scenarios.zh: 根据现场观察，研究团队发现交通拥堵在傍晚时段最为严重。
dual_scenarios.en: Based on observations at the site, the research team found that traffic congestion was worst in the late afternoon.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Ikut pemerhatian aku, kedai tu dah kurang sesak lepas pukul dua.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Berdasarkan pemerhatian saya, kedai itu sudah kurang sesak selepas pukul dua.
dual_scenarios.zh: 据我观察，那家店两点过后就没那么挤了。
dual_scenarios.en: From what I've noticed, that place is less crowded after two.
spoken_features: ikut 在口语中代替 berdasarkan

messages.ms_standard: Berdasarkan pemerhatian saya, kedai itu sudah kurang sesak selepas pukul dua.

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries connect pemerhatian with the perhati and hati word family. This offers a useful cultural picture: careful looking involves directing the heart or mind towards something. Modern usage distinguishes pemerhatian, observation, from pemerhati, the observer, and perhatian, attention. The distinction helps learners describe an activity, its participant, and mental focus separately. [DBP discussion](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/soalhati.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把词尾 -an 当作“活动档案”：pemerhati 是观察的人，pemerhatian 是观察这件事。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 在汇报或提出不同意见时，berdasarkan pemerhatian saya 比直接断言更审慎，也便于说明判断依据。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合研究、教学、工作记录与日常观察。谈论他人行为时宜陈述具体所见，避免把有限观察说成对人格的定论。
